result.reason: The revised prohibition is narrowed to Deerskin Products and includes the required term, 12-month cap, and carve-outs. However, the retained grant of an exclusive right to HDI to use the Deerskin brand for the relevant website remains an operative field-of-use restriction and is not clearly subject to the 12-month cap. In addition, the cap lacks a specified commencement date. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve the unrelated closeout exception and commercial structure.
